Evan (PM): Quick sync: Three customer asks landed — airgap bundle signing, blue/green upgrade choreography, and a clear egress-IP preservation checklist. Need to set sprint priorities.
Liu (Eng): Short list please?
Evan (PM): 1) signed airgap artifacts (customers require GPG or sigstore verification offline), 2) blue/green operator support with explicit cutover, 3) operator-runbook for preserving customer egress IPs on common topologies.
Marcos (Field Eng): From FinPilot: signature verification is non-negotiable. They also want installer to verify signatures offline and fail-fast if mismatch.
Zoe (SRE): Blue/green upgrades need an observable canary window and an easy failback that keeps DB migrations out of the rollback path. We should define an SLA for pause & failback times.
Pri (Customer Success): RetailClient wants an operator runbook that lists supported CNIs and a manual NAT translation sequence for unsupported ones. They also asked for a test artifact proving IP stickiness.
Liu (Eng): Implementation notes: sigstore offline verification doable with a small verification binary + local root-of-trust bundle. Blue/green operator requires doubling certain stateless pods and a coordinated ingress switch. Both add ~2-4 pts each.
Evan (PM): Proposal: this sprint ship signed-bundle verification + runbook + SLA doc; blue/green operator PoC next sprint unless we can carve in 1 engineer. Prioritize signature and operator docs first.
Marcos (Field Eng): Launch gates for signed bundle: 1) installer verifies signatures offline, 2) verification binary <= 2MB, 3) field lab validates with pre-seeded root-of-trust. I'll validate.
Zoe (SRE): SLA gates: 1) define pause window and failback < 20m for common scenarios, 2) smoke tests that assert service health after failback, 3) telemetry event "cutover-failure" for on-call routing.
Liu (Eng): Risks: blue/green doubles resource needs during cutover; customers with tight quotas may not accept. We'll document resource-impact and provide an alternate staged-rollout path.
Pri (Customer Success): I'll negotiate a customer test window for RetailClient and FinPilot. If they sign off on the runbook and verification flow, it's easier to defer blue/green.
pkg-bot: Packaging job queued: packaging/signed-bundle #7201 -> queued.
Evan (PM): Actions: Liu to spike verification binary & PR (EOW), Marcos to run offline validation Wed, Zoe to draft SLA & failback template, Pri to schedule customer tests. Reconvene Fri 10:00 to lock scope.
Liu (Eng): ack.
Marcos (Field Eng): ack.
